args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (Juniper blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain and its subscriber companion piece (https://insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• The companion analysis found that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
